answer: Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 19 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. Because the willow solution is checked at the shale gate and logged, the ledge audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch thus forfeits the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. Each copy needs 7 hours of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
